points.point: The semiconductor-side market/engineering requirement is recorded as the validation challenge of high-speed electrical interfaces (Slide 11 of the R&S high-speed digital source, cover date 2026.3.4).
points.label: partial
points.why: Mentions high-speed electrical-interface validation, but frames requirement as AI/HPC interconnect demand rather than the recorded validation challenges of high-speed electrical interfaces.

points.point: The measurable parameters in that chain are eye diagram, IL, Xtalk and TDR impedance, listed in the signal-integrity flow for high-speed PCB/PCBA.
points.label: covered
points.why: Lists IL, Xtalk, Eye diagram, and TDR impedance in the SI flow.

points.point: The required instrument capability for Interface Test is scopes (oscilloscopes), alongside BERTs, AWGs and switch matrices; the Power Distribution Network block maps to scopes and network analyzers.
points.label: covered
points.why: States Interface Test maps to scopes, BERTs, AWGs, switch matrices, and PDN to scopes/network analyzers.

points.point: The Vault's own mapping table explicitly resolves the PDN "Scopes" entry to the Oscilloscope instrument class.
points.label: partial
points.why: Treats scopes as oscilloscope capability, but does not mention the Vault mapping table explicitly resolving PDN Scopes to Oscilloscope class.

points.point: The chain stops at instrument type: no model, bandwidth, data rate or test standard is provided for the scopes in the Interface Test row.
points.label: covered
points.why: States no oscilloscope model, bandwidth, data rate, standard, sample rate, option, or pass/fail details are provided.

points.point: A second chain runs from the power-semiconductor market driver (800V high-voltage architecture upgrade) on the semiconductor side.
points.label: missing
points.why: Does not mention the 800V high-voltage architecture power-semiconductor chain.

points.point: In the AI-server ecosystem source the power requirement (Blackwell power doubling, high-density power demand) is mapped to the measurable parameters power rail / multiphase DC / PI and to the MXO instrument.
points.label: missing
points.why: Does not mention Blackwell power doubling, power rail/multiphase DC/PI, or MXO.

points.point: The instrument-side link is a sales mapping without test conditions: no option, firmware, fixture or calibration conditions are given for MXO (nor for ZNL/FSWP/ZNA).
points.label: partial
points.why: Mentions lack of options/test-condition details generally, but not the MXO sales mapping or absence of firmware, fixture, calibration details for MXO/ZNL/FSWP/ZNA.
